parameters.name: outputCapacity
parameters.meaning: number of writable i64 scratch slots; must be at least agentlang_output_capacity()

outputCapacityQuery.name: agentlang_output_capacity
outputCapacityQuery.meaning: minimum caller-provided scratch-slot capacity for the body and its reachable user-word closure

resultBuffer.logicalOutputCount: number of values the entry body returns
resultBuffer.requiredScratchCapacity: maximum output arity of the entry body or any reachable user word
resultBuffer.sharing: the entry body and nested user-word calls share the caller-provided scratch buffer; callers reserve outputCapacity slots, while wrappers return only logicalOutputCount values

preconditions: context is non-null and points to at least 32 bytes aligned to 8 bytes
status is non-null and points to an aligned 4-byte int32_t
outputCapacity is nonnegative and at least agentlang_output_capacity()
outputSlots is non-null and points to outputCapacity aligned 8-byte int64_t slots when capacity is nonzero; this is caller-owned per-invocation scratch storage shared by nested calls
agentlang_execute checks ABI version and capacity before initializing context or writing output slots
